status: pilot model; full program, implementation and measurement-concept mapping remains pending
datasetName: Reading First: achievement and implementation impacts (Gamse et al., 2008)
datasetDescription: Estimated effects of a US early-reading grant program on achievement, classroom instruction and implementation. Results distinguish measured learning outcomes from observed practices and self-reported delivery.
studyName: Reading First Impact Study (2008 final report)

newProperties.name: Confidence interval lower bound
newProperties.description: Lower endpoint of a confidence interval for the estimate on this record, in the estimate's stated unit.

newProperties.name: Confidence interval upper bound
newProperties.description: Upper endpoint of a confidence interval for the estimate on this record, in the estimate's stated unit.

newProperties.name: Confidence interval level
newProperties.description: Confidence level expressed as a fraction, such as 0.95 for a 95% interval.

arms.name: Reading First funded schools (RFIS)
arms.description: Schools receiving Reading First funding in the impact study. Grant allocation used regression-discontinuity rules in 17 sites and random assignment in one site.

arms.name: Reading First unfunded comparison schools (RFIS)
arms.description: Schools without Reading First funding used to estimate the study's counterfactual. Their observed means are distinct from the report's adjusted estimates of outcomes without funding.

pilotName: Reading First grade 1 comprehension impact: SAT 10 points (2005-2007)
pilotDescription: Adjusted reading-comprehension impact pooled across three spring assessments. The confidence interval includes zero; the estimate is not evidence of exactly no effect.
tableName: Student achievement: reported impact and uncertainty
identityDecision: Reading First, ReadingFirst, RFIS and report-number/name/URL probes found no matching study, program or source. RFIS substring results concern starfish and unrelated subjects. New confidence bounds are needed because existing confidence-interval fields are Text; existing lower/upper bounds describe cost ranges or biochemical flux. Name searches are complete within the documented query scope, not proof against every possible alias.
displayRules: Descriptions stay within two concise sentences; methods, coverage and cautions use Markdown blocks.
Effect, SE and CI bounds retain numeric values with explicit units; no global percent format on mixed-unit properties.
Confidence level uses the verified fraction-to-percent Format metadata.
P value uses the existing Text property to retain exact reported operators and decimal precision.
Do not label the study RCT-only or claim the 248 schools are the student sample size.
A raw effect and its standardized representation share one contrast and must remain linked; publishing the pilot alone does not establish those pair links.
